preconditions.description: The number of grooms n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of times the princess said 'Oh...' must be between 0 and 15.
The number of times the princess exclaimed 'Wow!' must be between 0 and 15.
The total number of grooms must be greater than the sum of 'Oh...' and 'Wow!' counts.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the fortunes of the grooms.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 50000 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each fortune value must be an integer between 1 and 50000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (a == sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if any(int(stdout.split()[i]) > int(stdout.split()[j]) for j in range(i))) and b == sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if int(stdout.split()[i]) > sum(int(stdout.split()[j]) for j in range(i))))
postconditions.description: The output must correctly reflect the number of 'Oh...' and 'Wow!' statements based on the sequence of fortunes.
